# Weeks on Fire

> AI-generated short-film series production hub: Grok Imagine visuals, Minimax Music cues, screenplays, and open prompt archives.

- Live site: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/
- Source: https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire
- Full agent brief: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/llms-full.txt

## What this is

Weeks on Fire is a personal cinematic experiment combining:
- **Visuals**: stills and frames from Grok Imagine (xAI)
- **Music**: Minimax Music style prompts, lyrics, and cutaway cues
- **Writing**: episode synopses, screenplays, scene breakdowns
- **Hub UI**: React + Vite gallery (Visual Archive, Timeline, Songs, Staff)

## Primary content (crawl these)

### Live app views (SPA; HTML shell also embeds key titles)
- Visual Archive — featured Episode 03 laser-snake stills + character refs
- Production Timeline — Episode 01 scene production JSON workflow
- Songs — Minimax catalog browser
- Staff — fictional series crew bios

### Episodes (markdown, fully readable without JS)
- Episode 1: https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire/tree/main/episodes/episode-01
- Episode 2: https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire/tree/main/episodes/episode-02
- Episode 3 (Laser Snakes): https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire/tree/main/episodes/episode-03

## Featured tracks

- Halloween Snake Battle (comedic thrash metal, instrumental)
- Les Ondes Courtes (French electro-chanson)
- Mysterium / Mysterium A Cappella (Italo bubblegum pop)
- Twilight Time (90s rave / eurodance)
- Whatever Lets Us Be (dark cabaret piano ballad)
